work_experience.title: Project Manager
bullets: Led a team of 20, allocating workload, managing backlogs, and tracking task and sprint status to improve resource utilization and support timely delivery of sprint commitments.

Built and executed Plans of Record across concurrent programs, managing scope, schedules, stakeholder communication, infrastructure setup, test plan coordination, and prioritization to drive on-time, on-budget, and in-scope delivery.
Tracked key program metrics and deviations from the Plan of Record, proactively escalating risks and issues and driving corrective actions to prevent schedule and delivery impacts.
Led sprint planning and Scrum calls, establishing task assignments, tracking milestones, and coordinating dependencies to maintain execution across multiple concurrent workstreams.
Collaborated with stakeholders to translate business and technical requirements into structured tasks, stories, and features, improving requirement clarity and reducing rework and downstream defects.

Delivered weekly program reviews and status reports to Director-level leadership, consolidating program health, metrics, risks, issues, and progress to drive cross-functional alignment and timely decision-making.

Built Tableau dashboards and daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports across motorcycle models, providing Sales and management with visibility into key metrics.

Coordinated with Sales, Service, Production, Logistics, and Operations to communicate customer requirements, resolve issues, manage dependencies, and maintain cross-functional alignment and execution.

job_posting.title: Customer Success Program Manager
job_posting.summary: Partner with cross-functional stakeholders across the business, use data to guide decisions, and own communication channels to create synergy and clarity at a global scale. Work on major projects including Agentic AI deployments, product adoption initiatives, and global maturity.

product_execution_and_delivery: Own assigned programs end-to-end, driving consistency, accuracy, and accountability.
Translate strategy into a prioritized, defensible plan, connecting day-to-day execution to broader business outcomes.
Exercise judgement on scope and priority, including defining the when and the how, with clear rationale.
data_metrics_and_decision_making: Define what success looks like before work begins, and measure outcomes rigorously after delivery to drive optimal adoption.
Use data as the primary input for prioritization and iteration decisions, not an afterthought.
Maintain strong data hygiene throughout the program lifecycle, and problem-solve or pivot when new information emerges.
audience_empathy_and_cross_functional_le: Build alignment and drive decisions across teams without relying on positional authority.
Navigate competing priorities with independent judgement that builds organizational trust over time.
Maintain an evidence-based understanding of the needs of the people you are building for, and anchor decisions to that understanding.
Right-size delivery based on the needs of different personas and stakeholder groups.
communication_and_resourcefulness: Communicate proactively and clearly with stakeholders at every level of the organization.
Navigate ambiguity with resourcefulness by building and maintaining the cross-functional relationships to close gaps.

requirements: 3 to 6 years of experience in program management, project management, operations, or a related field.
A track record of owning org-wide projects or programs from planning through delivery with minimal oversight.
Comfortable working with data to define success metrics, track outcomes, and make prioritization calls.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to different audiences.
A bias toward action, high attention to detail, and comfort operating in ambiguity.
Strong discernment while using Agentic and AI tools.
nice_to_have: Experience in a high growth SaaS or tech environment.
Familiarity with project management and data tooling (e.g., Asana, Jira, Salesforce, Snowflake or similar).
Exposure to operations, strategy, or business-process work in addition to core program management.
